notes.title: MAGIX Movie Edit Pro Plus Steam Edition Updated
notes.content:
Important updates in version 16.0.3.66 compared to version 16.0.3.64

Stability: Repaired various errors that may have led to crashes (import/playback)
Stability: Corrected issues with choppy playback/frozen playback marker
Speed: Removed loading time for OFX plugins
Usability: Corrected video blending error (reduced video no longer covers the entire background)
Usability: Optimized OFX plugin search
Import: Improved DVBT2 support

notes.title: MAGIX Movie Edit Pro Plus Steam Edition Updated
notes.content:
Important changes in version 16.0.2.56 compared to version 16.0.1.25

9 new intros & outros,10 new templates for automatic video editing and brandnew video border effects
Internal 16-bit color processing and 10-bit HEVC import
Wireless media transfer
General stability improvements
Improved travel route animation
Optimizations in the "Load backup project" dialog
Improved performance in 360° and effects
Minor corrections to the program interface and localization
